findings.quote: The notes and dates are summarised here so you can judge how much weight to give them
findings.why: The section claims notes and dates are summarised, but it gives no actual dates, per-day notes, weather or results, so the six-day test cannot be verified.
findings.fix: Add the real test dates, conditions and per-item results (for example a short test log table), or remove the testing claim and the 'worked in our trial' wording in the description.

findings.quote: Around the winter solstice, Reykjavik gets only about four to five hours of usable daylight. Late February brings roughly nine hours.
findings.why: The daylight figures are plausible, but no source sits next to them and the generic Sources list does not show which link backs which figure; this affects driving safety.
findings.fix: Link the daylight source directly after these sentences and say whether the figures mean sunrise to sunset or usable light.
